summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held 5 November 2026, at which all 25 resolutions in the Notice of Annual General Meeting 2026 passed on a poll. Routine governance items included the 2026 report and accounts (99.18% for), directors' remuneration report (97.92%) and policy (96.57%), declaration of the final dividend (99.91%), director appointments and re-appointments, auditor re-appointment and remuneration, share allotment authority, and renewal of the share buyback authority (99.83%). Special resolutions covered pre-emption disapplications, new articles, and reduced general meeting notice. No transaction terms were disclosed.
